content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Macon

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Macon professionals in manufacturing, logistics, and public sector roles typically meet these standards. Gather documentation of your background before applying to ensure a smooth submission process.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our experienced trainers deliver the required formal education on a schedule that fits working professionals. You'll gain practical knowledge and direct access to instructors throughout the program.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the boot camp, file your official PMI application online and pay the associated exam fee. Our team provides guidance on the submission process. PMI will review your credentials and send exam authorization once approved.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to reinforce course concepts and build confidence. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam at a local testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education options that help you stay current and maintain certification without interruption.
